Data.title: Money Supply (End Of Period), Historical Series, Monthly
Data.footnote: Net deposits with non-bank financial institutions excludes these institutions' deposits with banks. There are changes to the data submitted by financial institutions with the revision of MAS Notices 610 and 1003 and the removal of the Domestic Banking Unit (DBU) Asian Currency Unit (ACU) divide on 1 July 2021. Hence, money supply data have been revised from July 2021. The historical series on money supply were previously presented on DBU which were mostly denominated in Singapore dollar (SGD), while the current series report solely SGD-denominated activities. Data on money supply from July 2021 are available via the link https://tablebuilder.singstat.gov.sg/table/TS/M701111
